page.overview:
What is Cyanide?

Cyanide is the sixth song of Death Magnetic. It was written by all four members of the band. It was the first song from the album to be played live.

Sleep and dream of this Death angel's kiss Brings final bliss Completely

Empty they say, Death, won't you let me stay?

Empty they say, Death, hear me call your name, Call your name...
